crossRefs.note: I rose up to open for my beloved. My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with liquid myrrh, on the handles of the lock.
There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from…
There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.
He came to the disciples, and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us…
Wake up righteously, and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
“That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go…
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the…
“Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

translations.web: I will get up now, and go about the city; in the streets and in the squares I will seek him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
translations.bsb: I will arise now and go about the city, through the streets and squares. I will seek the one I love. So I sought him but did not find him.
translations.kjv: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found
translations.asv: I said, I will rise now, and go about the city; In the streets and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
